name: חָפְנִי
summary: Hophni and his brother Phinehas serve as priests at Shiloh. Both die on the day the Philistines capture the ark, as the sign given to their father Eli had foretold.

evidence.note: Hophni and Phinehas are named as Eli’s sons and priests of Yahweh at Shiloh.
Their deaths on one day are announced as a sign to Eli.
Both are with the ark when it is brought from Shiloh.
The brothers die and the ark is captured.
The messenger reports both deaths to Eli.

note: Two suggestions connect the name with Hebrew חֹפֶן ‘handful’ or Egyptian ḥfn ‘tadpole’ (Wb 3, 74). Samuel gives no explanation that would decide between them.
